guide.overview: SAMPLE DATA — this is not a description of Shanghai. It is placeholder narrative held under the reserved stub:sample source so that development and CI can exercise guide storage, per-field-group chunking and vector retrieval without shipping a single unsourced fact. The sample city is laid out as four invented areas: a sample old town, a sample riverside, a sample station district and a sample hill park. Nothing in this text was taken from a publisher, and none of it should ever be shown to a traveller.
guide.food: SAMPLE DATA — this is not a description of food in Shanghai. The sample food scene is written around three invented venues: a riverside market selling street food, a noodle house in the sample old town, and a night food street beside the sample station. It exists so that a query such as "street food" can be shown to retrieve the FOOD chunk rather than the overview, which is the whole point of embedding the three field groups separately.
guide.practical: SAMPLE DATA — this is not practical advice for Shanghai. Sample transport is a metro, a city bus, a river ferry, taxis and walking; the sample app pack lists one ride-hailing, transit, payment and translation app per country, all with deliberately unresolvable store links. Every opening time, fare, band and price in this dataset is a placeholder and must never be quoted to anyone.

replaces.detail: SAMPLE DATA — an invented suppression, present so the V21 shape is exercised end to end. The real statement this models (a global ride-hailing app that does not operate in a market, and the local app to install instead) is real curation and belongs to capability gate 17C — see F-34. ADR 010 §3 forbids a stub emitting a plausible travel fact, so the replaced app is deliberately fictional too.
